faq_product_quality_title: What makes Dana Steel products reliable?
faq_product_quality_description: Dana Steel Factory carefully manages production workflows to ensure high structural durability, rigorous coating consistency, and accurate profiling for dependable project use.
faq_product_categories_title: What steel profiles do you offer?
faq_product_categories_description: We specialize in Pre-Painted Galvanized Iron (PPGI), Galvanized Iron (GI), beautifully profiled roof tiles, and essential steel building accessories.
faq_power_solutions_title: Do you offer custom profiling and lengths?
faq_power_solutions_description: Yes. Dana Steel provides flexible cut-to-length options on profiled sheets to match the precise requirements of your industrial or residential projects.
faq_mobile_accessories_title: What structural steel accessories are available?
faq_mobile_accessories_description: We offer essential matching roofing accessories including standard ridges, gutters, valleys, and specialized industrial fasteners.
faq_storage_devices_title: Can you handle bulk or distributor wholesale orders?
faq_storage_devices_description: Yes, our factory setup in Adama is built to manage scalable wholesale allocations for corporate developers, trading houses, and nationwide distributors.
faq_pricing_description: Yes. Dana Steel focuses on providing high-grade commercial and industrial steel sheets at highly competitive market rates directly from our factory floor.
faq_availability_title: Are Dana Steel products distributed nationwide?
faq_availability_description: We supply and deliver our coated steel products to developers and distributors across all regions of Ethiopia from our main hub in Adama.
faq_warranty_support_title: Do you provide product technical sheets and certifications?
faq_warranty_support_description: Yes. We offer official material test certificates, thickness confirmations, and detailed technical documentation to support engineering inspections.
faq_customer_support_title: Can I get assistance with structural material take-offs?
faq_customer_support_description: Yes, the Dana Steel technical sales division can assist with structural measurements, profile matching, and comprehensive quote generation.
